annotations.title: Fetch a web page and return clean main text and Markdown plus title and metadata

description: Fetch a web page and return clean main text and Markdown plus title and metadata. Fetches a public URL (redirects followed and re-checked) and converts the HTML to clean text and Markdown: main/article content first, navigation/footers/scripts removed, links made absolute. Also returns title, description, language, canonical URL, headings and word count. Plain-text and JSON responses are returned as-is. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).

mode.description: "main" keeps the article/main region and drops nav/header/footer
